reviews.title: Hopeless
reviews.text: Not great when registering and you get a few questions in and it just stops you from continuing.  Trying to load in my pet and at the breed question the Next button is not selectable, pale blue so not functioning. Had to abandon.

reviews.title: Frustrating
reviews.text:
I installed the app and filled in my profile. 
It has automatically connected with a vet we had at our previous address 38 miles away (4 years ago) I’ve manually put in my current/new vet, but it won’t delete the old vet. If I want to make an appointment it only gives a choice of the old vet. They say I need to change it in my profile, but I have. 
Who can change it. Your app doesn’t have a help or contact detail.

reviews.title: Poor app and lack of support
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for over a year and it doesn’t load current info  and there is no tech support.

reviews.title: Sneaky behaviour
reviews.text:
Be warned, this app wants to paste the contents of your clipboard to who knows where every time it is opened. 
Been on your banking app? Been sending your other half naughty messages? Been sending your illicit affair naughty messages? 
This app wants to know about it and paste whatever you last copied somewhere, it doesn’t tell you where but the functionality is there. 
I recommend going into settings and setting the ‘Paste from other apps’ setting to deny. 
Why they need this is anyone’s guess but it’s quite deceitful behaviour considering you’re only there to talk to your vet!!!

reviews.title: What’s going on?
reviews.text: Was brilliant as a simple easy way to stay in touch with our vet to book appointments, order repeat prescriptions etc. For months now though I’ve been locked out of the app - it keeps asking me to enter my phone number then tells me there’s a problem processing the information. I’ve deleted and reloaded the app - same thing. I’ve tried logging in through the website on my laptop - the link from the site for pet owners to log in just spins and doesn’t go anywhere. Have been told by my vet that I’ll need to raise a support ticket directly - but can’t find any customer support/contact details anywhere so am posting this review in the (probably vain) hope that someone will tell me how to contact them & get this sorted.

reviews.title: Doesn’t help at all
reviews.text: Booked appointments don’t show and the chat isn’t minded
